welcome:
Welcome to the Linux CLI Playground.
Simulated Ubuntu 22.04 production web server running nginx + Node.js app.
Type 'help' for available commands, 'scenario' for guided labs.

steps.instruction: Check system uptime and load averages first.
Load is 12.4 on a 4-core box — that's 3x overloaded. List processes sorted by CPU.
A node process is eating 98% CPU. Check how much memory the system has available.
Memory looks OK. Check what that specific node process is doing.
Check disk I/O — maybe the process is thrashing.
Check if the node app is writing excessive logs.
The error.log is 4.2GB! Check the nginx service status to see the bigger picture.
Restart the node app service to recover.
Check disk usage across all filesystems.
Root filesystem is at 97%! Find what's eating space in /var.
/var/log is 18GB. Find the biggest log files.
Find files larger than 100MB anywhere on the system.
Find old log files (older than 30 days) that can be safely removed.
Check what processes have deleted files still open (holding disk space).
Check the journal logs size too.
Vacuum old journal logs to free space.

  top / htop                 — Process monitor
  kill / pkill               — Send signals to processes
  df -h                      — Disk filesystem usage
  du -sh                     — Directory size
  free -h                    — Memory usage
  uptime                     — System uptime + load
  uname -a                   — Kernel info
  lscpu                      — CPU info
  ls -la                     — List files with details
  find                       — Search for files
  tail / head                — View file start/end
  ss -tlnp                   — Network sockets
  ip addr / ip route         — Network config
  systemctl                  — Service management
  journalctl                 — System logs
  dmesg                      — Kernel messages
  chmod / chown              — Permissions
  lsblk / mount              — Block devices
  iostat / vmstat            — I/O and VM stats
  curl / ping / dig          — Network utilities

  lsof                       — Open files

  scenario                   — Start a guided lab
  clear                      — Clear the terminal
  help                       — Show this help
